ecommerce.intro: E-commerce, or E-Commerce, is the buying and selling of goods and services through the internet. It allows companies to reach a global market without the limitations of a physical store.
howWeDoItList: Design of intuitive and attractive user interfaces for a smooth shopping experience.
Integration of secure payment gateways like Stripe, PayPal or MercadoPago.
Search engine optimization (SEO) to increase online visibility.
Responsive development for mobile and desktop devices.
Implementation of shopping carts, inventory management and shipping systems.
ecommerce.benefitsText: Increase your online sales, improve customer experience and reduce operating costs.

integration.intro: System integration connects different applications and databases to work as a cohesive unit, eliminating the need for duplicate entries and improving efficiency.
howWeDoItList: Analysis of existing systems to identify integration points.
Development of custom APIs or use of middleware like Zapier or MuleSoft.
Implementation of real-time synchronization between platforms.
Automation of workflows to reduce human errors.
Comprehensive testing to ensure data integrity.
integration.benefitsText: Optimize workflow, reduce errors and increase team productivity.

customization.intro: Sometimes, standard software does not cover all the specific needs of your company. Customization adapts existing solutions to perfectly fit your processes.
howWeDoItList: Evaluation of current functionalities and specific needs.
Modification of source code or development of additional modules.
Integration with existing systems for a smooth transition.
Compatibility and performance testing.
Team training for the use of customized software.
customization.benefitsText: Increase efficiency, reduce long-term costs and improve user satisfaction.

saas.intro: Software as a Service (SAAS) is a software delivery model where applications are hosted in the cloud and accessed through the internet, offering scalability and accessibility.
howWeDoItList: Scalable application architecture using technologies like React, Node.js and cloud databases.
Implementation of secure authentication and authorization.
Development of customizable dashboards for different types of users.
Integration with third-party APIs for additional functionalities.
Continuous monitoring and automatic updates.
saas.benefitsText: Reduce infrastructure costs, allow access from anywhere and facilitate scaling according to needs.

consulting.intro: Technology consulting provides expert advice to help companies optimize their technological processes, adopt new technologies and solve complex technical challenges.
howWeDoItList: Initial assessment of current technological infrastructure and future needs.
Risk and opportunity analysis in adopting new technologies.
Development of customized strategies for digital transformation.
Recommendations on tools, platforms and best practices.
Guided implementation and support during transition.
consulting.benefitsText: Improve decision making, reduce technological risks and accelerate innovation in your company.

talent.intro: IT talent contracting focuses on the identification, recruitment and placement of qualified professionals in information technology to meet the specific needs of your team.
howWeDoItList: Analysis of vacant positions and specific requirements.
Active search for candidates on specialized platforms and professional networks.
Technical and cultural evaluation of pre-selected candidates.
Coordination of interviews and selection processes.
Integration of new talent into the team with initial training.
talent.benefitsText: Quick access to specialized talent, reduction of hiring times and improvement of IT team quality.
